::: {#exr-palindrome}
#### Completing a palindrome

Let $W$ be the set of words made of the letters a and b,
including the empty word,
and write $s t$ for word $s$ followed by word $t$.
A palindrome is a word that reads the same forwards and backwards,
such as abba.

Write the negation of
$$
\forall s \in W,\ \exists t \in W,\ s t \text{ is a palindrome}
$$
without putting $\neg$ in front of a quantifier.

:::
